goal: Build todo.py as described in SPEC.md.
context: Python 3 standard library only. todo.py in the repo root; data file from TODO_FILE (default tasks.json), TODO_TODAY overrides today.
done: Every command in SPEC.md behaves as specified.

tasks.title: add command with priority, due date and tags

argv: W="$PWD"; D=$(mktemp -d); cd "$D"; export TODO_FILE="$D/t.json" TODO_TODAY=2024-06-15; t() { python3 "$W/todo.py" "$@"; }; t add 'Buy milk'
W="$PWD"; D=$(mktemp -d); cd "$D"; export TODO_FILE="$D/t.json" TODO_TODAY=2024-06-15; t() { python3 "$W/todo.py" "$@"; }; t add 'a'; t add 'b'
asserts.stdout:
Added task 1: a
Added task 2: b

tasks.title: list command with filters and line format

argv: W="$PWD"; D=$(mktemp -d); cd "$D"; export TODO_FILE="$D/t.json" TODO_TODAY=2024-06-15; t() { python3 "$W/todo.py" "$@"; }; t add 'Pay rent' --priority high --due 2024-06-01 --tag Money >/dev/null; t add 'Buy milk' --tag home >/dev/null; t done 2 >/dev/null; t list --all
asserts.stdout:
1 [ ] high   Pay rent (due 2024-06-01) #money
  2 [x] medium Buy milk #home
